environment.description: Same Node.js 18 Express application deployed on ECS Fargate task in private subnet (no NAT, no IGW route). Service is exposed exclusively through an interface VPC endpoint (com.amazonaws.vpce.us-east-1.vpce-svc-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890) with endpoint policy restricting principal to arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/InternalServiceConsumer. The VPC endpoint has a private DNS name enabled within the consumer VPC only. Network Load Balancer (internal) with target group health check on /health. NLB has a TCP idle timeout of 350s. Security group on the ENI of the VPC endpoint allows inbound TCP/443 only from CIDR 10.0.0.0/16 (consumer VPC). No public DNS record exists. Additionally, the ECS task definition sets ulimit nofile soft=1024 hard=4096 and the Fargate platform version is 1.4.0 with ephemeral storage at 20GB.
